lines: Ay Yüzlüm: I'm looking for the guy I love. Is he here????
Uqi: Depends on how much love?
Uqi: But I guess he's here
intro.title: Moonlight Courier
intro.subtitle: One message. Only you can deliver it.
intro.howTo: Drag to steer as you catch the stars, grab the hearts, and dodge the grey clouds.

checkpoints.title: The first letter
checkpoints.caption: same story
checkpoints.quote: The last time i use it was like 3 years ago. And i install it back the day i sent you a letter
checkpoints.text: The universe knew it was finally time for us to find each other.

checkpoints.title: Is he here?
checkpoints.caption: where it started
checkpoints.quote: Im looking for the guy i love is he here????

checkpoints.question: Our very first day. What did you promise me?
options: To always answer my first call
To still love me after I go bald
To let me win at Uno
checkpoints.reveal: Are you sure??? Now, say swear

checkpoints.title: The first call
checkpoints.caption: you, nervous
checkpoints.quote: After the first call, I will always bother you with my calls; you can't get rid of me
checkpoints.text: I'll never get rid of you. Even once a day is never enough to hear you talk

checkpoints.title: Ay Yüzlüm
checkpoints.caption: my moon-faced one
checkpoints.quote: 'pretty like the moon' and the translation is 'my moon-faced one'
checkpoints.text: And in Indonesia, Ay sounds like sAYang. Your name works in both our languages.

checkpoints.question: How many messages did we send this year?
checkpoints.reveal: And we talked on all 365 days. Not one missed.

checkpoints.title: My birthday
checkpoints.quote: connection is not about proximity, but about hearts choosing each other again and again.
checkpoints.text: A whole letter, from Türkiye. I still read it.

checkpoints.question: Which song did you translate for me?
checkpoints.reveal: "I choose the song because i wanted to." I still have it.

checkpoints.title: New year
checkpoints.quote: Hopefully this new year will bring a lot of happiness to you and us

checkpoints.question: How many times did I call you "salak"?
checkpoints.reveal: You called me salak 1,312 times. Still losing, salak.

checkpoints.title: Five months
checkpoints.caption: exactly 5
checkpoints.quote: Okay just hate me i know you never want it to be 5 months
checkpoints.text: I said "Exactly 5 months." We never agree on how long it's been.

checkpoints.question: "Im a smart woman." What did I reply?
checkpoints.reveal: Then "Clean Air by Laufey". At that time, you said I still didn't say I love you. I love you sosososoosos muchhhhh askitom.

checkpoints.title: In my dreams
checkpoints.caption: did you feel it?
checkpoints.quote: Im gonna kiss you in my dreams so im letting you know if you feel it
checkpoints.text: I did. I kiss you back now.

checkpoints.question: Your longest "I love you sooo…". How many o's?
checkpoints.reveal: I tried to answer. You still won.

checkpoints.title: Uno nights
checkpoints.caption: loser (you)
checkpoints.quote: But you are the loser always💜
checkpoints.text: Losing to you never felt like losing.

checkpoints.question: How many times did you say "I love you" this year?
checkpoints.reveal: Me: 835. I owe you 1,030. Starting now.

checkpoints.title: Good night, aşkım
checkpoints.caption: every night
checkpoints.text: Is that even a question, bro? Dreaming about you is the only reason for me to feel good in the morning.

finale.line: 9,571 km apart. 365 days. Not one missed.
letter: Happy anniversary, askitom. As I sit here today thinking about us, I realize just how much we’ve been through over the past year. I won’t pretend it’s been perfectly smooth sailing. We’ve definitely had our fair share of bumps in the road, misunderstandings, and moments where the thousands of miles between us felt heavier than usual. Navigating a relationship from Indonesia all the way to Turkey takes a lot of effort, and there were definitely days when the time difference and the screen between us made things incredibly hard.

But even on the toughest days, the one thing that never changed was my desire to make this work with you. The fact that we’ve had our rough patches and still managed to hold onto each other just proves how real this is. We keep choosing each other, even when it’s not easy, and I am so proud of us for that. Thank you for sticking by my side, for the late-night calls, for your patience, and for loving me through the messy parts of the year. I miss you more than words can say, and I cannot wait for the day when we finally don't have to rely on a phone to see each other. Until then, I’m sending you all my love, bebiskitom.
